title: Advanced CSV parser, data cleaning, and analytical transformation engine. Parses
description: Advanced CSV parser, data cleaning, and analytical transformation engine. Parses raw multipart CSV files, performs automated formatting fixes (removes invalid characters, strips leading/trailing whitespaces), and applies advanced filtering, sorting, and column drops. Outputs fully parsed clean tables in structured JSON, optimized CSV format, or synthesizes a professional PDF summary report with numerical statistics (averages, maximums, minimums, null counts).
